title: Checkout API latency after database deployment
symptoms: p95 latency rose from 420ms to 3.8s after a database deployment; intermittent checkout timeouts.
root_cause: A missing composite index caused sequential scans on the orders table.
resolution: Added the composite index, rolled back the query-plan change, and verified latency recovery.

title: Checkout timeouts during evening traffic
symptoms: Checkout requests timed out while database CPU reached 92%; error rate increased.
root_cause: A high-cardinality query caused repeated full scans under concurrent traffic.
resolution: Added a covering index and temporarily reduced expensive retry behavior.

title: Order search became slow after schema change
symptoms: Order lookup latency increased immediately after a schema migration.
root_cause: The migration removed an index used by the most frequent customer lookup query.
resolution: Restored the index and added a migration check to the deployment pipeline.
